text:
Mia: FWIW I just noticed the EU ingest lag caused a pileup of late telemetry for the last 36h. Aggregates are stale for a bunch of hourly views. Thinking we should run a two-pass reprocess: a narrow high-priority pass for last 12h + a sampled, cost-capped sweep for older hours. Opinions?
Omar: +1 to two-pass. can we avoid full shard grabs — last time cost spiked because we kept expanding slot sizes.
Leah: agree. also need to surface expected token/compute estimate in console before kicking. operators kept starting full runs without seeing cost.
Tess: can we do windowed jobs with a de-dup prefilter? i.e. dedupe keys that already have aggregates and only diff anything newer than watermark. saves a ton.
Ryan: spiked S3 latency caused delayed kafka commits; we should mark the origin in the replay job to exclude already-processed offsets. not sure current replayer supports origin tagging.
sre-bot: alert: ingest-eu-high-latency 3111109000 resolved 20m ago.
Mia: good note @Ryan — we should add origin_tag in replay metadata. Proposal: priority-fold policy: 1) hours h in [now-12h..now] => full coverage, high priority queue; 2) hours h in (now-12h..now-72h] => 10% systematic sample by tenant, low-priority; 3) older than 72h => skip unless explicitly requested.
Omar: Do we have a sampling SQL or selection logic ready? need deterministic sampling so reruns are reproducible.
Leah: deterministic sample example: hash(tenant_id || hour) % 100 < X. So for 10% sample: hash % 100 < 10. Could be YAML in job config.
Tess: sample snippet I prototyped: 
```
sample_rate: 0.10
selector_sql: |
  SELECT tenant_id, hour
  FROM telemetry_index
  WHERE hour > now() - interval '72 hours'
  AND (abs(hash_text(concat(tenant_id, hour))) % 100) < (sample_rate * 100)
```
Works with our job runner and deterministic hash.
Ryan: Nice. we should also gate the low-priority queue by a compute cap per tenant per window, otherwise big customers dominate sample slots.
Mia: agreed — add per-tenant cap. Proposal: low-priority cap: max 2 concurrent slots / tenant, and global low-priority concurrency = 50.
Omar: +1. Also suggest a backfill-id header so we can trace which reprocess run caused a metric bump. add to tracing and to cost logs.
Leah: Console UX asks: show estimated CPU-hours and S3 egress estimate before start + a compact progress bar and an option to auto-cancel if cost > budget. Can console-bot show a dry-run estimate?
console-bot: dry-run API available at POST /replay/dryrun -> returns {estimate_cpu_hours, estimate_s3_gb, sample_count}. Needs job spec.
Tess: can we add a flag to the job spec: allow_partial_commit: true/false. For sampled runs we want partial commits (write intermediate aggregates) so operators can see improvement progressively and stop if something looks off.
Mia: partial commits make sense for near-term windows. For high-priority last-12h run we should commit atomically to avoid half-baked hourly aggregates during live traffic.
Ryan: atomic commit for last-12h + partial for sampled older windows = good compromise. Also suggest a canary: run last-12h for 1% tenants first, check regressions on eval prompts.
Omar: small nit: need to ensure dedupe logic is idempotent — we rely on upserts with last_write_wins; make sure watermark comparisons use event ingestion_time not arrival_time.
Leah: agreed. add unit tests for idempotency. Also devex: provide a one-click console template for the priority-fold policy so SRE can reuse it.
Mia: timeline? I can wire the job config & dry-run integration today if people are cool with policy. we should also post-mortem the S3 incident to identify why kafka commits delayed.
Ryan: I'll add origin_tag support in replay runner. ETA EOD.
Tess: I'll PR the sample selector + per-tenant cap logic. ETA tomorrow morning.
sre-bot: runbook note: if replay queue > 500 tasks, auto-throttle low-priority queue to 0.
Mia: +1 to auto-throttle. let's do this: i) implement policy + dry-run, ii) enable canary run for 1% tenants on last-12h, iii) after canary passes, start full last-12h high-priority, iv) start sampled sweep with caps. I'll update the console template and post the config here.
Omar: thanks. please tag me on the PR for the dry-run estimate UI so I can review the cost calc.
Leah: I'll add UX copy for the console: "Estimated compute: X CPU-hours | Estimated S3: Y GB | Expected duration: Z mins — This is a cost-estimate, actual cost may vary."
Mia: putting a quick config draft below so ops can trial: 
```
replay_policy: priority_fold_v1
high_priority_window: 12h
sample_window: 72h
sample_rate: 0.10
low_priority_concurrency: 50
per_tenant_slots: 2
allow_partial_commit: true
commit_mode_high_priority: atomic
commit_mode_low_priority: partial
trace_header: replay-backfill-id
```
Omar: LGTM. will review tomorrow.
console-bot: dry-run endpoint: curl -X POST https://api.redwood/replay/dryrun -d '{"spec":"<yaml>"}' -> returns JSON estimate.
Tess: will open PR with selector + unit tests.
Mia: thanks all. I'll start wiring console template and will ping once dry-run integrated. :thumbsup:
Ryan: heading into the runner PR now.
Leah: will draft console copy and add a warning banner for EU-late-ingest incidents.
Mia: closing loop: if anything urgent pops, call it out in #eng-sre. Otherwise we'll coordinate merges tomorrow morning.
